rationale: The proposed topology improves the binding constraints (NF and S21) by adding a source degeneration inductor to enhance input matching and increase gain bandwidth, while preserving stability and current efficiency. This addresses the poor NF and low S21 by increasing the effective input impedance and improving transconductance efficiency in the 5.8 GHz band, without increasing power or violating the device budget. The inductor provides a resonant path that boosts S21 and reduces noise by optimizing the input impedance match to 50Ω, directly attacking the most negative margins.
